information_gain.highest_value_next_query: Inspect changed current function bodies only for material callee-path changes against historical callees, while preserving historical/current separation.
information_gain.reason: This distinguishes harmless implementation drift from changed dependency topology at lower cost than broad database re-inventory.

queries.sql: SELECT id, created_at, jsonb_object_keys(payload) AS payload_key FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161 ORDER BY payload_key;
queries.result_summary: Event 20161 exists at 2026-10-04 05:14:40.880842+00 and exposes caller, trigger, external inventory, usage, scope and provenance fields.

queries.sql: SELECT jsonb_pretty(payload->'sql_callers'->0) AS first_caller, jsonb_pretty(payload->'trigger_bindings'->0) AS first_trigger, jsonb_pretty(payload->'external_inventory'->0) AS first_external, jsonb_pretty(payload->'usage_stats') AS usage_stats, jsonb_pretty(payload->'scope_guards') AS scope_guards FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161;
queries.result_summary: Historical caller rows include caller, callees, caller_oid, definition_md5, operational_class and currentness_source; usage_stats says track_functions=none and zero stat rows cannot prove no usage; scope_guards says no production/runtime changes.

queries.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT payload FROM public.lf_eventos WHERE id=20161), callers AS (SELECT x->>'caller' caller,x->>'definition_md5' historical_md5,x->>'operational_class' operational_class,x->>'currentness_source' source_label,x->'callees' callees FROM e,jsonb_array_elements(payload->'sql_callers') x), live AS (SELECT n.nspname||'.'||p.proname caller,count(*) overloads,array_agg(md5(p.prosrc) ORDER BY p.oid) current_prosrc_md5 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) snapshot_rows,count(DISTINCT c.caller) unique_callers,sum(jsonb_array_length(c.callees)) lexical_edges,count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.caller IS NULL) absent_current_names,count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.caller IS NOT NULL AND c.historical_md5=ANY(l.current_prosrc_md5)) at_least_one_current_hash_match,count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.caller IS NOT NULL AND NOT(c.historical_md5=ANY(l.current_prosrc_md5))) current_name_but_hash_changed FROM callers c LEFT JOIN live l USING(caller);
queries.result_summary: 38 snapshot rows, 38 unique callers, 76 lexical edges, 0 absent current names, 16 empirical historical/current md5(prosrc) matches and 22 current names with changed empirical hash.

queries.sql: Compare event 20161 trigger_bindings by table_name+trigger_name with current pg_trigger and trigger function identity.
queries.result_summary: 21 historical trigger rows; 21 exact current trigger matches; 0 missing trigger bindings; 0 trigger-function name mismatches.

queries.sql: Expand event 20161 external_inventory and count rows/distinct dedupe_key.
queries.result_summary: 6 external rows and 6 unique external dedupe keys spanning ACTIVE/CANDIDATE/CANDIDATE_TEST and multiple governance lifecycle states.

findings.claim: The historical SQL caller identity set remains name-resolvable today, but the snapshot cannot certify current function definitions: 22/38 caller names have a different empirical md5(prosrc) than the historical definition_md5.
findings.limit: The historical hash construction method is not proven canonical by this comparison; matching is empirical only.

findings.claim: Broad trigger-binding drift is falsified at current name/function mapping level for the 21 bindings in the snapshot.
The six external inventory entries form a separate identity/lifecycle domain; no evidence here justifies adding them to the 38 SQL-caller denominator.

negative_falsifiers.hypothesis: Most historical caller names disappeared from current pg_proc.
Trigger rebinding is the dominant topology drift visible from the P0 trigger set.
Historical definition_md5 equals md5(prosrc) by proven canonical contract.

causal_hypothesis.claim: A material false-currentness risk exists because function definitions changed after the historical snapshot while caller identities and trigger bindings largely persisted. Whether those changes alter the relevant dependency paths remains unproven.

minimal_safe_action: Inspect only the 22 changed current bodies for material changes in the historical callee relations before any live-topology or optimization conclusion.
unresolved: Whether any of the 22 changed bodies altered relevant callee paths
